'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Jonathan Murray LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonathan Murray]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: QMC is for lovers.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Throdo
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
